figurative_meaning_bn: কর্ণপাত করা; গুরুত্ব/পাত্তা/প্রশ্রয় দেওয়া; গ্রাহ্য করা
figurative_meaning_en: to pay attention; to give importance/notice/indulgence; to take into account
example_sentences_in_english: It is proper to pay heed to the government's instructions.
note: The idiom is commonly used in both positive and negative contexts, often advising against indiscriminate attention.
